checks.name: minimum-spacing
checks.description: Every node respects the canonical minimum spacing.

checks.name: hub-exclusion
checks.description: Hub nodes maintain mutual exclusion zones.

checks.name: boundary-padding
checks.description: Cluster centroids and hubs stay within the padded boundary.

checks.name: cluster-containment
checks.description: All non-bridge cluster members stay within their cluster boundary.

checks.name: bridge-visibility
checks.description: Bridge nodes are visible between clusters.

checks.name: dependency-corridor
checks.description: Dependency edges flow left-to-right along corridors (informational for force layout).

checks.name: label-reservation
checks.description: Label reservation is enforced as part of minimum spacing.

checks.name: viewport-integrity
checks.description: Layout bounds are finite and non-degenerate.

checks.name: determinism-compatibility
checks.description: Layout positions are deterministic and finite.

checks.name: renderer-independence
checks.description: Layout contains only world-space coordinates and no renderer artifacts.

checks.name: semantic-gravity
checks.description: Semantic gravity remains at or above baseline

checks.name: hub-placement
checks.description: Hub placement remains at or above baseline

checks.name: bridge-preservation
checks.description: Bridge preservation remains at or above baseline

checks.name: lod-compatibility
checks.description: LOD compatibility remains at or above baseline

checks.name: viewport-framing
checks.description: Viewport framing remains at or above baseline

checks.name: renderer-compatibility
checks.description: Renderer compatibility remains at or above baseline

checks.name: projection-compatibility
checks.description: Projection compatibility remains at or above baseline

checks.name: collision-improvement
checks.description: Collision reduction remains at or above baseline

checks.name: crossing-improvement
checks.description: Crossing reduction remains at or above baseline
